meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le tapis', plural 'les tapis') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'carpet'.

examples.text: Elle marche sur le tapis rouge.
examples.trans: She walks on the red carpet.

examples.text: C'est fait! Et le tapis bleu va juste à côté du lit.
examples.trans: Done! And the blue rug fits right beside the bed.

examples.text: Et pas de miroir au mur, et le sol semble nu sans tapis.
examples.trans: And no mirror on the wall, and the floor feels bare without a rug.
Everything is going well.
